title: 64% of Shoppers Are Waiting for Thanksgiving Weekend. Here's the Small-Brand Playbook.
yt_title: Small Business Saturday 2026: A Holiday Playbook

slides.label: The money
slides.text: NRF expects holiday sales to grow *4.2%* to a record *$1.013 trillion*.

slides.label: The wait
slides.text: *64%* of shoppers plan to wait until *Thanksgiving weekend*, up from 51% five years ago.

slides.label: The shift
slides.text: Only *53%* plan to shop online, the lowest since 2015. *27%* want to give an *experience*.

slides.label: Nov 28
slides.text: *Small Business Saturday.* 71% of local shoppers say they do it to *support their community*.

slides.label: The play
slides.text: *Announce early, sell late.* Sell an experience. Show up in person. Make *value visible*.
